title: Meta opens Muse Spark 1.1 and previews a direct model API
friendlyTitle: Meta offers a stronger Muse Spark model and a new way for developers to use it
summary: Meta has introduced Muse Spark 1.1, a multimodal reasoning model aimed at tool use, computer interaction, coding and visual understanding. It is available in Thinking mode in Meta AI, alongside a public preview of the Meta Model API for developers.
friendlySummary: Muse Spark 1.1 is designed for reasoning, coding, using tools and understanding images. People can try it in Meta AI, and developers can preview a direct API.
whyItMatters: The API gives developers another route to an agent-oriented multimodal model, while consumers can try the model without building an application. Teams should compare task reliability, regional availability and data terms with established model providers.
friendlyWhyItMatters: This adds another choice for building or trying AI agents. Compare its results, availability and privacy terms before choosing it for regular work.
